newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm, pushed up by Lek.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm, pushed up by Lek.

text.p: Slovenian shares continued their rise for the fourth consecutive trading session on Monday, pushed up by gains in drug producer Lek.
"Prices are still seen as low, but volumes are low before Wednesday's holidays, so each purchase really exaggerates price moves," one broker said, adding he sees the market capped at present levels.
* The SBI index rose 0.24 percent or 2.97 points to 1,223.7.
* Drug maker Lek was the top gainer, jumping 3.14 percent to 23,000 tolars on volume of 357 shares.
* Mineral water producer and health resort operator Radenska was the most active, rising 2.63 percent to 1,600 tolars on volume of 2,881 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
